# 01 — Scaffold

**What**
I set up the project skeleton. It has config, tests and a Makefile.

**Why**
Later work needs one shared base. Without it, every commit invents its own setup.

**Number**
No number yet. I will measure it in commit 08.

**Trade-off**
I spent time on tooling before features. It pays back in every later commit.

**Likely follow-up question**
Q: Why put all numbers in one YAML file?
A: It keeps tuning in one place. A reviewer can see every knob at once.
